paper_title: Aerobic Oxidation of PMB Ethers to Carboxylic Acids

questions.question: In this paper, what does the abbreviation 'PMB' (as in PMB ether) stand for?
What is the chemical name of compound 12 (denoted (R)-12) that was prepared in the total synthesis shown in Scheme 4?
Under the paper's standard catalytic aerobic oxidation conditions for converting PMB ether 1a to carboxylic acid 2a, what solvent, catalysts (with loadings) and atmosphere were used?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Solvent: DCE (1.0 mL); Catalysts: Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (10 mol%) and TEMPO (10 mol%); Atmosphere: O2 (oxygen balloon) at room temperature (≈25 °C).

questions.question: Which reaction gave the higher NMR yield of carboxylic acid 2a under the paper's standard conditions: oxidation of PMB ether 1a or oxidation of the corresponding alcohol 1a'?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Oxidation of PMB ether 1a gave the higher yield: 94% NMR (1a → 2a) vs 55% NMR for the corresponding alcohol 1a' → 2a.
